_comment: Single source of truth for every size budget. scripts/perf/bundle-budget.ts reads
the route budgets, tests/e2e/bike3d/bundle-budget.spec.ts reads lazy3dChunkGzipBytes,
and scripts/perf/compare.ts reads timingLadder. Nothing hard-codes a number.
All sizes are GZIPPED BYTES of the JavaScript a browser must download before the
route is interactive: the shared framework chunks plus the route's own eager client
chunks. Legacy `nomodule` polyfills and CSS are excluded (they are not what a 3D
viewer regression shows up in).
RATCHET POLICY (decided by the user, 2026-09-12, overriding the flat §7.3 numbers).
`firstLoadJsGzipBytes` is re-pinned at EVERY wave integration to the freshly measured
value + 10 %, rounded up to a whole KiB. The gate therefore catches an unexpected jump
rather than an absolute the framework floor already exceeds, and every raise is a
visible diff in this file. `targetGzipBytes` stays at §7.3's numbers (130 kB / 140 kB);
W4-T2 ratchets the ceilings down toward them.
Why the plan's flat numbers were dropped: an EMPTY Next 16.3.4 + React 19 + next-intl
App Router route already measures 130.7 kB gzip (W0-T3a, 2026-09-11), and the W0 shell
(header, footer, locale switcher, NextIntlClientProvider) measures 154.6 KiB (W0 integration,
2026-09-12) — both above the 130 kB the plan asks for.
Pin history (sizes are KiB, as scripts/perf/bundle-budget.ts prints them; ceiling = measured + 10 %, rounded up to a whole KiB):
W0 integration 2026-09-12: home 154.6 KiB -> 171 008 B. (Recorded then as 154 600 B: the table's 'kB' is KiB, so that pin had +8 % headroom, not +10 %.)
W1 integration 2026-09-13: home 157.7 KiB (161485 B) -> 178176 B; guide 159.6 KiB (163430 B, first build of the route) -> 180224 B.
Home is +28.6 KiB: W2-T2 replaced the placeholder with the real interactive decision tree
(client tree + OptionGrid + HelpDisclosure + Summary, lib/bike/{local-bike,spec-codec,describe},
and the DECISION_TREE data the client needs to navigate). NOT illustrations: the ~70 drawings are
RSC-rendered by components/decision-tree/tree-illustrations.tsx and ship zero client JS, and
`forbidWebgl` still passes, so no 3D leaked in. Measured on the CI-equivalent build
(ENABLE_TEST_PAGES=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_TEST_HOOKS=1), which is what the CI build job produces.
Home is 56 KiB above its 130 kB target; W4-T2 owns closing that gap.
W2 integration 2026-09-18 (final, all five branches merged): home 195 739 B -> 216 064; guide 166 026 B -> 183 296;
The four /velo + garage routes enter the ratchet here. `forbidWebgl` is ON for the workspace routes on purpose:
the 3D viewer is lazily imported, so THREE in an EAGER chunk there is the regression worth catching.
Home ROSE 190 820 -> 195 739 net of two opposing moves: W2-T2's tree and W2-T3's shared code pushed it up,
the drawings leaving the RSC payload (.debug/007) pulled it down. Mounting sonner's Toaster in the shared
layout cost +8.5 KiB on EVERY route until it was made lazy (components/ui-ext/Notices.tsx) — a layout import
is paid by every page in the site, which is why these six numbers are measured together after every merge.
W3 integration 2026-09-20 (.debug/010 §12): home 195 790 B (pin kept 216 064); guide 166 028 B (kept 183 296);
controle 221 886 B -> 244 736, liste 243 941 B -> 269 312 and acheter 214 674 B -> 236 544 enter the ratchet here.
/velo/[id] +11 kB: §6.4's pick mode and status tint. All three new routes pass `forbidWebgl`. (This entry was
recorded only in the debug note at the time; copied here in W4 so the history is complete in one place.)
W4 integration 2026-09-21 (.debug/012; measured + 10 % applied only where it LOWERS a ceiling):
reglages 217 908 B, mes-velos 192 012 B and acheter 215 732 B KEPT at their W3 pins (239 616 /
209 920 / 236 544): measured + 10 % would have raised them 1-2 KiB (W4-T2's scoped translators, W4-T1's
prefill and link rule), and a ceiling only moves down without a reason worth a raise; headroom 8.5-9.1 %.
/velo/[id] fell 2.1 kB: W4-T2 scoped the part panel's messages (the RSC flight, not this table, took most
of that win: /fr/velo/demo 93 052 -> 36 366 B). lazy3dChunkGzipBytes 409 600 -> 396 208: the first pin from
a real run since W0, min(409 600, ceil(344 528 x 1.15)), measured FR = EN by bundle-budget.spec.ts on the
e2e build. Home is still 61 KiB over its 130 KiB target, below which the framework floor already sits
(docs/backlog.md has the per-package breakdown).
Getting the numbers: `npx tsx scripts/perf/bundle-budget.ts --json` prints raw gzip bytes and the
ratchet's `nextPin` (measured + 10 %, rounded up to a whole KiB) for each route.
